[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 64[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to another Hack Forum News edition. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[hr]

[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2745296]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6331317][color=#ffffff]Scrolling Text Ads[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Scrolling text adverts are now being implemented to Hack Forums, an idea given to [mention=1] by his wife, the scrolling text adverts will start at $25 per week and adjust accordingly for demand. You may need too hard refresh the page for these to be displayed properly. Would you consider purchasing one of these? Or have any other feedback now is the time to share your thoughts in the original thread.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6330078][color=#ffffff]CTF Challenge $1000+ Prize Pool [CanYouHack.Me and Virtualine.net][/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

With just two days left in this CTF challenge, there is no better time than now to begin collecting your entries. You can earn entries by completing challenges the more challenges you finish the better your chances to win higher tier prizes and the exclusive CYHM award. Thank you to [mention=5555096] for sponsoring this event. Remember to complete the introductory “NotBB” 1st challenge to unlock exclusive Virtualine coupons. Best of luck to everyone taking part.

[u][b][size=large]The Blood of Dawnwalker[/size][/b][/u]

Has surpassed 1 million copies sold in just three days since its September 3 launch.

[u][b][size=large]GTA 6 Spikes UK Console Sales[/size][/b][/u]

A highly anticipated preview of Grand Theft Auto 6 on Netflix sparked a massive hardware surge in the UK, with PlayStation 5 sales jumping 33% and Xbox Series X|S sales climbing 34% week over week.

[u][b][size=large]Xbox Limits Cloud Playtime[/size][/b][/u]

Microsoft has implemented a new cap on Xbox Cloud Gaming, restricting subscribers to 15 hours of playtime per month.

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/ves-brown.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=5458992]

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]Keep Fighting[/size][/b][/color]

Life doesn't always give us a choice about what we have to face. There will be moments when everything feels too difficult, when plans fall apart, people disappoint us, and giving up seems easier than taking another step.

But fighting doesn't always mean being the strongest person in the room. Sometimes fighting means getting out of bed when you don't feel like it. It means trying again after failing, standing back up after being knocked down, and refusing to let one bad chapter define your entire story.

You don't have to win every battle. Some battles simply teach you how strong you can become.

There will be days when progress is barely noticeable. Keep going anyway. The fact that you're still fighting means the story isn't over.

[hr]

[color=#FF851B][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]

You don't have to be fearless to keep fighting. Be afraid, be tired, be uncertain—but keep moving forward.

[hr]

[color=#008E02][size=15]Quote of the week[/size][/color]

“It's not whether you get knocked down, it's whether you get up.”
— Vince Lombardi
